👉 **[Open AuroraVPN Live Site & APK Download](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/6eec2cf3-7e9c-43bf-b64f-c7ff2458ee63/2689fc35d25582cea6ad5e48/)**

---

### 📦 Direct Downloads Ready in Your Repository
- **[AuroraVPN.apk](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/downloads/AuroraVPN.apk)** (v1.0.0, 37.6 MB) — Full-featured Android VPN client.
- **[AuroraVPN-Shadowsocks.apk](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/downloads/AuroraVPN-Shadowsocks.apk)** (24.9 MB) — Stealth obfuscation client for bypassing strict network firewalls.

---

### 🛠️ What Was Built

1. **Native Android Source Code**:
   - [`AuroraVpnService.kt`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/app/src/main/java/com/auroravpn/app/service/AuroraVpnService.kt): Core [`AuroraVpnService`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/app/src/main/java/com/auroravpn/app/service/AuroraVpnService.kt#L29) managing TUN interface allocation (`VpnService.Builder()`), packet routing loops, socket protection (`protect(socket)`), and foreground status notifications.
   - [`MainActivity.kt`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/app/src/main/java/com/auroravpn/app/ui/MainActivity.kt): UI controller handling `VpnService.prepare()` permission prompts, server selection, live bandwidth graphs, and protocol switching.
   - [`AuroraVpnTileService.kt`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/app/src/main/java/com/auroravpn/app/service/AuroraVpnTileService.kt): Android Quick Settings toggle tile.
   - [`VpnServer.kt`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/app/src/main/java/com/auroravpn/app/model/VpnServer.kt): 10 global server configurations (🇺🇸 USA, 🇩🇪 Germany, 🇬🇧 UK, 🇯🇵 Japan, 🇸🇬 Singapore, 🇨🇭 Switzerland, etc.).
   - [`AndroidManifest.xml`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml) & Gradle files: Configured for Android 7.0+ (API 24 to 34).

2. **Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD**:
   - [`.github/workflows/build-apk.yml`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/.github/workflows/build-apk.yml): Automatically builds `AuroraVPN-debug.apk` with Gradle and publishes GitHub Releases whenever you push to GitHub.

3. **Interactive Web App & Mobile Phone Simulator**:
   - [`index.html`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/index.html), [`styles.css`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/styles.css), [`app.js`](https://github.com/AlRayes84/first-project-2/blob/main/app.js):
     - Interactive smartphone preview with live connection toggle, animated pulse ring, real-time speedometers, and diagnostic TUN logs.
     - One-click WireGuard (`.conf`) and OpenVPN (`.ovpn`) profile generator.
     - Step-by-step sideloading and installation guide for Android.

Everything is committed and pushed automatically to your GitHub repository `AlRayes84/first-project-2`.
